notes.title: Lust Academy Final: Major Update is Live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45287206/e62da8d51f0d1ef5d62f9d44c25e76a38b22be40.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Over the past few months, we’ve received a lot of feedback from you (our amazing players), and we’ve heard a recurring theme: the ending of Lust Academy left some of you with unanswered questions.[/p][p]So… we’ve decided to fix that.[/p][p]Today, we’re releasing the major update, which adds even more depth to the story and gives you a clearer picture of what really happened at the end of your magical journey. [/p][p]Consider it our way of saying thanks for sticking with us and for caring enough to share your thoughts.[/p][p]What's new in:[/p][list][*][p]15 brand new mini scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Around 200 new renders[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and minor improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the new content, and don’t hesitate to drop us a line, change a review, or leave your thoughts in the discussions![/p][p][i]Love, 
Bear in the Night Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Season 3. Final Weekly DevBlog Update
notes.content:
[b]Well, hello there![/b]

[i]Looks like you've stumbled across our weekly DevUpdate, and here's the joke of the week:
How do mermaids call their friends?
...
 On their "shell"-phones![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675743/cefa6eed11fd5ec6c97e87d240295cb0590c295c.png[/img]

Here's the list of what we've done in the previous week:
[list]
[*] Finished [b]all[/b] remaning [b]renders[/b] for Lust Academy season 3.
[*] Retouched [b]all[/b] remaning [b]renders[/b] for Lust Academy season 3.
[*] Finished [b]all[/b] remaning [b]animations[/b] for Lust Academy season 3.
[*] Finished updating [b]skins[/b] for BIO.
[*] Finished working on the save file transfer function for season 4.
[*] Finished planning storylines for Season 4.
[*] Finished sound design for Season 3.
[/list]
As you can see, Lust Academy season 3 is almost finished and heading to its steam release, while we're already in preparation for Season 4. That's it for today!

One more: let us remind you about a chance to win [b]Steam gift cards[/b].

To participate, [b]add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655960/Lust_Academy__Season_3/]Lust Academy Season 3[/url] to your wishlist[/b] 🙏 and c[b]lick the celebration emoji "🎉"[/b] in [url=https://discord.gg/rZvx5nmX][b]our Discord channel[/b][/url]. 

 [b]15 [/b]ones will receive [b]$10 Steam Gift cards[/b] each. 
We aim to hit [b]+5,000[/b] new wishlists since the start of the contest for Season 3, and once we achieve that, we're upping the ante! We'll throw[b] two extra $100 gift cards[/b] into the prize pool! Let's make it a reality 🌟
  
Just hit that participate button, and our trusty bot will randomly pick a winner. 
And remember, the more friends you invite to join and wishlist, the closer we get to that ultimate prize!

notes.content:
[h3]Greetings everyone![/h3]

We are more than happy to announce that [b]Lust Element[/b] page is live on [b]Steam[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675743/6258de29438f7ca1bfc68074c5077871530daa9e.png[/img]

[b]Start your intergalactic adventure[/b] as a captain of a slapdash assembled team aboard a mining spaceship. Though it begins as an easy mission to earn quick money, you'll quickly realize that you've got involved in something much bigger...

[b]The universe of Lust Element[/b] has various alien species, both primitive and far more advanced than humans. On your journey, you'll get a chance to meet and get to know them better. notes.title: Meet Lust Academy trading cards!
notes.content:
[h2]Meet Lust Academy trading cards![/h2]
[h3]Earn trading cards, badges, profile pics & more![/h3]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/807390082076114984/970020334470299728/All_st.jpg?width=544&height=463[/img]

We're happy to announce that from now on,  by playing Lust Academy, you can earn one of 14 unique trading cards with beautiful characters! Such as: Haley, Samantha, Naomi, Lily, Adele, Victoria & Audrey and others!

And if you're new to steam trading cards, you'd be pleasantly surprised to know that by trading a set of these cards, you can earn a special badge for your steam profile! You'll also get a unique profile pic and background. But the coolest part is that you can actually trade cards up to five times to increase badge level and get additional rewards. How cool is that?

We hope you'll enjoy this news and the new possibilities! 

[b]Thank you for your support and attention.[/b]

[i]Sincerely, 
Bear in the Night team[/i]
